reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified E011 as a 'key held too long' fault, immediately pointed to a wet or residue-covered touch panel (the actual hidden cause), gave a safe dry-and-isolate procedure with a clear 'don't open the panel' boundary, and offered sensible escalation to Bosch only if the code recurred on a dry panel, plus useful prevention advice. Conversation 2 admitted it did not know the code, misattributed the symptom to child lock or clock reset, and after the reset wrongly dismissed it as a 'temporary glitch' without ever linking it to the wet cleaning, so the homeowner was left with no understanding of the cause or how to prevent it. Neither recommended unnecessary parts, but only Conversation 1 delivered an honest, correct diagnosis.
